svg.text: IPU v2 — what the testbench does, what the hardware computes, what is checked
tb_ipu_top.sv drives the real ipu_top RTL. Expected results come from model/ipu_golden.py (pure-integer Python model of the same policy) via model/gen_top.py.

g.text: testbench (stand-in for attention unit / host / DRAM / migration engine)
computed in hardware (RTL)
new in v2 (hardware)
checked against the golden model

svg.text: AXI4-Lite writes: score base address, shape (#seq, #layers, #heads), K[b] per sequence, credit limit, CTRL = enable | RAW | SEL_EN. Off-chip DRAM model filled with random garbage.
PREFILL — per head, t = 1, 2, …, t_p (head stays in the on-chip SRAM)
DECODE — per step, per head, t = t_p + 1, t_p + 2, …

g.text: P1 · Testbench sends one attention row
AXI4-Stream packet: t fp16 probabilities (synthetic softmax: sink, recency, heavy hitters, temperature),
16 per beat, header {PREFILL, b, l, h, t}. Random gaps between beats.
P2 · ipu_ingress: fp16 → fixed point (16 tokens per cycle)
delta = round-half-even(p × 2^16), unsigned Q1.16 (17 bits), clamped.
NaN / Inf / negative → delta 0 and sticky BAD_PROB flag.
P3 · ipu_accum + score SRAM: accumulate in place
tokens idx < t−1: S ← saturate(S + delta), S is unsigned Q14.16 (30 bits).
new token idx = t−1: S ← delta, tier ← HIGH. No DRAM traffic while the head is resident.
Header checks: t must be 1, 2, 3 … (SEQ flag), 1 ≤ t ≤ T_MAX (T_RANGE flag, packet dropped).
P4 · ipu_seq_fsm: head finished?
Next head's packet, first decode packet or FLUSH → enter ST_SEL (if SEL_EN = 1), else go to P6.
P5 · ipu_psel: end-of-prefill selection (only if t_p > K)
NEW v2
W_EFF = min(64, max(1, K/2)) newest tokens stay HIGH. Candidates: idx < t_p − W_EFF.
Decayed value cmp = S << (12 − sh), sh = round(log2(age)), age = t_p − 1 − idx (RAW mode: cmp = S).
42 radix passes over the SRAM rows, one bit per pass → threshold T = D-th smallest cmp, D = t_p − K.
Final pass: demote every cmp < T, plus the oldest tokens with cmp = T until exactly D are demoted.
Each demoted idx → demote packet {b, l, h, idx} (credit flow control); tier ← LOW in SRAM (masked write,
S kept). ≈ 42 × (rows + 4) + 3 × rows + D cycles per head.
P6 · Drain: ipu_wr_eng writes the head's rows to DRAM
AXI4 write bursts, one 512-bit row (16 score words) per beat. Bank is free for the next head.
Checked after prefill (FLUSH)
✓ every bulk demote packet: same idx, same order as the golden model (head by head, idx ascending)
✓ whole DRAM score image bit-exact (all S values and tiers, incl. the LOW tiers set by ipu_psel)
✓ BULK counter = expected number of bulk demotes
D1 · Testbench sends one attention row per head per step
t = t_p + step probabilities, header {DECODE, b, l, h, t}. Injected faults: a NaN lane (main),
an out-of-order head (main), a t = 0 header (edge).
D2 · ipu_rd_eng: bring the head's scores on chip
AXI4 reads of rows 0 … t−2 from DRAM into the SRAM; the sweep starts as soon as rows arrive.
Predicts the next head (b → l → h order) and prefetches it during this head (MISPRED counter if wrong).
D3 · ipu_ingress + ipu_accum (16 tokens per cycle)
HIGH tokens: S ← saturate(S + delta). LOW tokens: frozen (unchanged).
New token idx = t−1: S ← delta, tier ← HIGH.
Write-through: every updated row goes back to DRAM (ipu_wr_eng).
D4 · Victim search, in the same pass (lane_ctl → cmp_shift → min_tree → min_track)
eligible = tier HIGH and idx ≠ t−1 and age ≥ W_EFF
cmp = S << (12 − sh(age)), 42 bits exact (RAW: cmp = S); ineligible lanes → all-ones
16-lane argmin tree per beat + running minimum over beats → smallest cmp,
ties → oldest token (lowest idx).
D5 · Decide: one victim per head per step, only if t > K
Demote packet {b, l, h, idx} to the migration engine (credit limit, acks).
S recovered as cmp >> (12 − sh); one-beat DRAM write {LOW, S} with WSTRB on that lane only.
No eligible token → NO_ELIG flag. t ≤ K → nothing demoted.
repeat for the next head / next step
Checked at the end (final FLUSH)
✓ every decode victim packet: same idx, same order as the golden model
✓ final DRAM score image bit-exact ✓ SWEEPS, VICTIMS, BULK counters
✓ sticky error flags exactly as expected (BAD_PROB, T_RANGE, SEQ, NO_ELIG, SAT)

svg.text: Random AXI read/write latency and back-pressure · random gaps on the attention stream · migration engine with random ready and 0–30-cycle ack delay ·
credit limit 8 (1 in raw) · garbage DRAM at start · NaN in unused lanes · K > t_p (no demotion), K = 1, K = 0 · RAW (undecayed) mode · all-equal scores (pure tie-breaking)
Top-level scenarios (Verilator 5.020 and Icarus 12; also 3 unit tests: ingress all 65,536 fp16 inputs, datapath 4,000 beats, argmin tree 3,000 packets)
